extracted_concepts.name: Ratio
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A comparison of two quantities using ratio language.

extracted_concepts.name: Unit Rate
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A rate associated with a ratio comparing a quantity to one unit.

extracted_concepts.name: Equivalent Ratios
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Ratios that describe the same relationship and can be shown in tables.

extracted_concepts.name: Proportional Relationship
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A relationship between two quantities with a constant ratio.

extracted_concepts.name: Constant of Proportionality
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The constant ratio identified in tables, equations, and graphs.

extracted_concepts.name: Rational Number
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A number that can be written as a ratio of integers.

extracted_concepts.name: Irrational Number
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A number that is not rational.

extracted_concepts.name: Greatest Common Factor
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The greatest common factor of two whole numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: Least Common Multiple
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The least common multiple of two whole numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: Absolute Value
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The distance of a rational number from zero.

extracted_concepts.name: Number Line
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A line used to represent positive and negative numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: Exponent
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A symbol used to show repeated multiplication.

extracted_concepts.name: Radical
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A root expression involving square roots or cube roots.

extracted_concepts.name: Square Root
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A value represented by a square root symbol.

extracted_concepts.name: Cube Root
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A value represented by a cube root symbol.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear Expression
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An expression with variables and rational coefficients.

extracted_concepts.name: Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A statement that two expressions are equal.

extracted_concepts.name: Inequality
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A statement using forms such as x > c or x < c.

extracted_concepts.name: Coordinate Plane
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A plane used to plot points and figures using coordinates.

extracted_concepts.name: Polygon
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A closed two-dimensional figure with straight sides.

extracted_concepts.name: Volume
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The amount of space occupied by a three-dimensional figure.

extracted_concepts.name: Net
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A two-dimensional representation of a three-dimensional figure.

extracted_concepts.name: Statistical Question
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A question that anticipates variability in data.

extracted_concepts.name: Measures of Center
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Quantitative summaries such as median and mean.

extracted_concepts.name: Measures of Variability
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Quantitative summaries such as interquartile range and mean absolute deviation.

extracted_concepts.name: Mean
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A measure of center found by averaging data values.

extracted_concepts.name: Median
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A measure of center representing the middle value.

extracted_concepts.name: Interquartile Range
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A measure of variability describing the spread of the middle half of data.

extracted_concepts.name: Mean Absolute Deviation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A measure of variability around the mean.

extracted_concepts.name: Dot Plot
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A display of numerical data on a number line.

extracted_concepts.name: Histogram
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A display of numerical data grouped into intervals.

extracted_concepts.name: Box Plot
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A display summarizing numerical data using quartiles.

extracted_concepts.name: Random Sampling
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A method used to draw inferences about a population.

extracted_concepts.name: Probability Model
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A model used to investigate chance processes.

extracted_concepts.name: Slope
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The rate of change represented by m in a linear relationship.

extracted_concepts.name: Similar Triangles
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Triangles used to explain why slope is the same between points.

extracted_concepts.name: Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A rule that assigns to each input exactly one output.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function defined by an equation of the form y = mx + b.

extracted_concepts.name: Pythagorean Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A theorem relating the side lengths of a right triangle.

extracted_concepts.name: Scatter Plot
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A graph for bivariate measurement data showing associations.

Give quantitative measures of variability (mean absolute deviation).
